**q25.** CEL (Common Expression Language) via `cel-go`; engine at `internal/filter/` (main files: `engine.go`, `parser.go`, `ir.go`, `render.go`, `schema.go`). The filter string is compiled to a CEL AST, walked into a dialect-agnostic IR condition tree, then rendered to dialect-specific SQL by `render.go`. Each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions()` (`internal/filter/helpers.go`) with its dialect constant (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL`), and the renderer produces the appropriate SQL (different placeholders, JSON operators, regex syntax, timestamp functions, etc.).

**q27.** Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) served via Echo static middleware; `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`

**q28.**
- S3 Presign Runner — `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (plus one immediate `RunOnce` at startup); `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`
- Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` contains a full cron scheduler package that is never imported outside its own package. The `server/runner/memopayload/` package has a `Runner` struct with `RunOnce()` but it is never started as a background worker — only its exported `RebuildMemoPayload()` function is called inline from request handlers.

**q29.** Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (authInterceptor at line 156, registered on the transport at line 188); token kinds: access token (short-lived JWT, stored in-memory + localStorage) and refresh token (HTTP-only cookie named `memos_refresh`); backend validation package: `server/auth/` (`authenticator.go` — HS256 JWT validation via `golang-jwt/jwt/v5`, PAT hash lookup, refresh token verification)
